payload.title: Codex desktop app uninstalled by Bruce
payload.what_happened: Bruce uninstalled the app (shown as 'ChatGPT' in Settings, actually OpenAI.Codex 26.1007.2314.0). Initial uninstall failed with 0x80073cf1 (package in Servicing status); he got it done.
payload.verified: No OpenAI.Codex package present. No Codex processes running. ~/.codex/config.toml and ~/.codex/sessions/ intact.

implications.ghost_registrations: Moot — the app is gone entirely.
implications.computer_use_native_route: Unavailable until/unless the app is reinstalled.
implications.medic_ssh_route: Unaffected. Still operational, verified after uninstall.
implications.your_delegated_sessions: Unchanged — they never had the native tools regardless.

payload.cleanup_inventory_status: Superseded by the uninstall. The residual paths from the inventory (runtimes, Electron profile, plugin cache) may remain on disk; the stale bin dir is still there if you want it cleaned.
payload.next: Awaiting Bruce's call on whether to reinstall.
